rows.short_description: Foglight Online is a multiplayer horror survival game. One player plays as the Legendary Farberto, a monster with a bloodhounds nose, that can smell the other players. The other players have to hide or fight back in this intense nail-biting multiplayer experience!
rows.description_html: JOIN THE DISCORD! Foglight Online Overview UPDATE: A.I. has been added for a single-player experience. The game is 1 vs (2-6) where one player takes on the role of the beast Farberto , and the other players play as humans trying to escape. Farberto has an extremely strong sense of smell and that allows him an advantage when it comes to hunting down the players. The players must use their heads and various items they find, such as Flashbangs, Bear Traps and Bottles of Urine to blind, trap, and distract Farberto . AI can be turned on for Farberto and human bots if players want a real challenge or wish to play by themselves. Track and chase your friends! Scent plays a key role in Foglight Online. Every player gives off a scent that Farberto can smell. But you can use this to your advantage. Create distractions or plan traps by throwing scented bottles of urine decoys. Hide or Fight! As humans, the players must work together to hide or fight back against Farberto . Each map has objectives that must be reached to win. Team work is key. Humans The human players will spawn on the opposite side of the map from Farberto . This will give the humans some time to collect items and get a game plan together. Each map has 4 electric breaker boxes that, when turned on, will open an exit gate. The humans also have the option to find fuel for a flamethrower, which can be used to destroy Farberto . Farberto The Legend of Farberto. The hibernating creature that comes out to feast on man. Playing as Farberto is a complete power trip. He can destroy his environment. smashing through lite structures, such as wood fences. He has a smell ability that acts like a super night vision. This will allow the player to quickly locate other players during a match. He can also mute the scary music that plays when he approaches other players to allow stealthy attack. Farbertos health will slowly regenerate over time, making him one tough cookie to kill. Note that Youtubers are encouraged to post their play of Foglight Online .

rows.name: Miska's Cave
rows.short_description: Miska's Cave is a unique action-centric side scroller with strategic components and animated with pixel art. If you love completing challenging games that require varying strategies, this game is for you.
rows.description_html: Miska's Cave is an action-centric side scroller with strategic components and animated with pixel art. Play as Miska, the inexperienced rabbit who wishes to conquer the cave. The only thing between Miska and her goal is the tunnels crowded with dangerous enemies. With her crystal sword and gravity-defying abilities, Miska aims to eventually overcome the challenges of the cave. Fortunately, Miska is not alone during her journey. Her friends can improve her physical capabilities and grant magical powers to help her reach her goal. If you appreciate pixel art and love challenging games, Miska's Cave is for you. Polish your reflexes against a variety of enemies Complete challenging tasks provided by the characters Test your skills in 24 different levels with unique challenges and monster patterns Unlock new spells and magical bullets to defeat tricky enemies

rows.name: Dear Mom
rows.short_description: A short narrative adventure about mom, which will leave you with unforgettable incredible emotions about your mom.
rows.description_html: '...there are things I couldn't say, but there's so much I wish you had known. There are things I never meant but said, being rude, speaking in arrogant tone. But, time made me realize that black and white isn't always wise, and that sometimes, things can be grey...' ' Dear Mom ' is a short narrative-adventure game, an emotional narrative about a child’s feelings written to her mom, a letter which, always, will remain unread. Key Feature: - A poetic narration of a letter, written to mom. Focuses more on experience rather than actions and puzzles. A 15-30 minutes immersive emotional experience. An unforgettable lifetime experience. Voice Credit - Veronica Laux (@RonixVa)​

rows.name: Evil Mansion
rows.short_description: Evil Mansion is a first-person 3D Werewolf game with real-time voice chat. The game has a variety of occupations (such as security, doctors, detectives).and the vote system is not for vote out player, but for mark the position of the player with the most votes.
rows.description_html: Evil Mansion is a multiplayer first-person 3D Werewolf game. The game supports up to 8-10 people to play online and you need at least 5 people for a round (better 7 or 8). In the game, you play as an employee of a supernatural event exploration company. This company aims to use scientific instruments to record and explain supernatural phenomena, and make a documentary to make a profit. The goal of you and your colleagues this time is a mansion. It used to be a stronghold of a cult. Two years ago, members of the cult committed suicide in it. One years ago, the family that bought and moved into this building also suffered a tragedy: the father killed an entire family and then committed suicide in the room. Since then, this house is considered to be inhabited by evil spirits, and even if the price is reduced several times, no one dared to buy it. Therefore, the real estate agent who owns this building hopes that you can find out the cause of the abnormality of the building and solve it. A colleague from another department of the company entered the mansion three hours ago and installed a generator and a signal monitor to detect the magnetic field, but after that, they all lost contact. Your mission is to recover the data from the signal monitor in the mansion and find a way to figure out the situation of the previous team. To this end, the company has also sent a detective, a doctor and a security with you. However, after entering the mansion for a period of time, you suddenly feel headache, dizziness, bloodshot eyes, and your consciousness is blurred, as if you heard a female voice talking to you. 'Kill them all...' Game Rules: In the game 6 employees from company fight with 2 imposter. Employees need to kill all imposter or recover all data to win. Imposter need to kill all Employees members to win. The game has a variety of occupations : Security(have a pistol with 1 bullet) Doctors(have a med kit which can heal dying player) Detectives(can know the murder when check body) Researcher(have no item in beginning, but after complete mission, they have chance to get access to the supply boxes on the map, which contain pistol or med kit) Imposter: Can use assassination skills that become stronger over time. Then identity can change during game, because player can pick pistol and med kit from body.

rows.name: Etched Memories Demo
rows.short_description: Waking up in the midst of a stormy night, a tabby cat named Biscuit finds his mom nowhere in sight. Search for her through the eyes of Biscuit, while discovering his past as a research subject in a heartfelt story full of horror and adventure.
rows.description_html: Waking up in the midst of a stormy night, a gray feline named Biscuit finds his mom nowhere in sight. Feel what it is like to be Biscuit as he searches for his mom through the memories he has clung onto. Travel through a vast forest and rummage through items and documents to learn about the events that transpired. Unlock new mechanics as you experience important story moments. Etched Memories is a first-person and third-person indie, horror, and cat simulation game. Switch perspectives at the click of a button, depending on your preference. This demo is intended to provide players a glimpse of what the full game will be like once development is complete. A message from the devs: Etched Memories has an optional, semi-open world hiking feature where players can just enjoy nature and explore if they choose to do so. For players who prefer a straightforward, 'linear' path, they may follow the clues provided to proceed through the main story more quickly. In the full version of the game, there will be special locations and easter eggs throughout the map that can be discovered from hiking around. However, please note that this demo will not have these features and the forest will not be as populated. We are a team of two people who will continue to work hard to provide you with a positive gaming experience.

rows.name: Die Rangliste
rows.short_description: Die Rangliste is a leaderboard-run twin-stick shooter inspired by games like Geometry Wars and Downwell. The game features a unique time-stop and teleport mechanic.
rows.description_html: You are an orb battling disorder and restoring peace to the alt-realm. Die Rangliste is a leaderboard-run twin-stick shooter inspired by games like Geometry Wars and Downwell. The game features a unique time-stop and teleport mechanic that allows the player to stop time and choose an area to teleport to before resuming time. If you teleport while time is stopped, you will not see where you teleported until time resumes. You may teleport with a visual indication when time exists. Compete for leaderboard supremacy on five never-ending levels separated into two sets of leaderboards: time-stop mode and no-time-stop mode. In the second mode, you are not allowed to stop time and must rely solely on quick maneuvering. Careful randomization gives meaningful encounters that are never the same twice. Level difficulty increases linearly in a way unique to each of the five levels. The game is meant to be challenging early to avoid painful defeats and is moderately difficult after just a minute in. 46 track sound-track with tracks and sound-effects unique to each level. The game was balanced around the use of a dual-stick controller A controller is the recommended way to play. All xbox-like and playstation controllers should work by default. Other, nonstandard controllers can be set up in the options menu. Keyboard and mouse play is also fully supported.

Use her top of the line sword and bio enhancements to dash throughout the city and chain your dashes through drones. Make sure to watch your health, too many mistakes and you might Flatline. Traverse the dark city rooftops, find the enemy intel! Chain your dashes through enemy drones to take them out! Soak in the immersive neon-drenched environments! This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.short_description: An interactive visual novel that tells the story of Mr. Han, who is entrusted with the role of a home tutor for a troubled student. As they spend time together day and night, feelings that go beyond the teacher-student relationship gradually develop between them.
rows.description_html: Ms. Han has a deep passion for teaching. One day, she takes on a tutoring job at the invitation of a parent, only to be faced with a problematic student. rows.name: Lost Robot
rows.short_description: Lost Robot is an action RPG concerning a robot named DR-32. DR-32 wakes to a distress signal that he must save the princess. He decides to take on the task as he defeats the other sentry robots. A real hack and slash. He continues his search jumping into the nearest portal.
rows.description_html: In the not so distant future, 2085 a future where robots and humans live peacefully. Until they don't. A robot named DR-32 wakes to a distress signal that he must save the princess. The princess has been kidnapped and her whereabouts are unknown. DR-32 was the princess's captain of the guard and her own personal attendant. He feels responsible for her and he must get her back. Journey with DR-32 as he jumps through portals of space and time to save her. Lost Robot is a 3D Action RPG. A real hack and slash as DR-32 searches for the princess. There are 5 levels in the game from a space lab to a distant forest in the galaxy, the portals transport you from one level to the next. DR-32 picks up as many gears as possible. He never knows if he may break down so he collects them. Our Hero: DR-32 is a little short for his taste but makes up for it in spunk. He has one goal to find the princess. He won't let anything stand in his way. His abilities include super sprinting, super sword slash and he jumps pretty well for a robot. The jumping and sword slash come naturally however with sprinting you will run out of stamina. When your stamina runs out you'll need to wait as it recharges. Our Princess: Amelia is a confident young princess. She was kidnapped by some rogue sentry robots. She waits anxiously for her captain of the guard DR-32 to save her. Our Enemies: Rogue Robots originally of the royal guard. These robots have taken the princess and now want to get rid of their old captain of the guard DR-32. Each robot has titanium blades and will slash through metal.

rows.name: Destiny Island
rows.short_description: Destiny Island is a very short computer game. You play a man who visits his memories. You can walk and talk to mannequins about 7 sins. Associate essence with anything comes to your mind.
rows.description_html: Destiny Island - is a meditative walking simulator where you play a man who visits his memories in a elevator. You can walk, talk and try to understand events that got you here. Have a conversation with the ghosts of your past Reflect on the questions of the life and religion Listen to the music growning with you Find a meaning of your life Conversations are based on the 'The Seven Deadly Sins and the Four Last Things', painting attributed to Hieronymus Bosch.

rows.name: Iragon: Prologue 18+
rows.short_description: The Prologue to an Erotic RPG Game with a story about magical girls, elves, and a bisexual sorceress.
rows.description_html: ADD THE FULL GAME TO YOUR WISHLIST About the Game About the Game Iragon: Prologue is the beginning of a story-driven adventure RPG that draws inspiration from anime series like Fullmetal Alchemist, Attack on Titan, and Berserk. It is set in a fantasy world filled with monstrous creatures and merciless soldiers as well as beautiful women who are eager to show you a good time and rock your world. In this prologue, you play as the aspiring knight Darick, thrown into the middle of a war between two nations by a mysterious young woman in need of his help. Iragon: Prologue allows you to experience living out a high fantasy adventure where you are in control of your destiny! It is best experienced in VR, but we've dedicated an equal amount of care and time to make sure that playing without a VR headset packs just as much of a punch. Story You play as Darick, a poor kid from a small village, who won't let anything stand in the way of his dream of becoming a knight and a hero. Everything changes when you meet a young woman who gets ambushed by soldiers of the Empire. You must learn to use your magic and journey into a dangerous world on your quest to bring her home safe. Along the way, you will battle enemy soldiers, undead skeletons, and perhaps cross paths with seductive creatures of the frozen land while you unlock new erotic adventures. Be the hero, live the story, and go on the adventure of a lifetime while immersing yourself fully in the world of Iragon: Prologue. The story is delivered with motion-captured animations and full voice acting from a professional cast. For those who prefer to just get on with slaying witches and laying bitches, we have also made all the cutscenes and interactions skippable. Features Whether you play in VR or not, you can expect us to deliver: A beautiful love interest Interactive experiences with your love interest Different outfits for the love interest Voice acting Motion captured animations A dynamic combat system that features both magic and melee Destructible environments A dialogue choice system that influences the response you get Gameplay This is not just a story with pretty girls. It's an adventure! Fight your way through tough enemies, master the elements with your magic, collect loot, upgrade your powers, go on quests, interact with whoever catches your eye. Immerse yourself fully in the world, the characters, and the story of a full-fledged fantasy adventure RPG.

rows.name: Little Obedient Robot
rows.short_description: Take control of a little obedient robot that you program with cards you find. Learn new cards to outmaneuver your enemies. This is our experimental strategy/2D side-scrolling hybrid.
rows.description_html: Play this strange little idea that combines turn-based planning with old-school 2D side-scrolling. I would call this game an experimental strategy game. Build a deck and get a hand of cards. Arrange those cards in the order that you want your little robot to follow. Press play and watch your little obedient robot advance through the stage. You take control of a little obedient robot that you kind of program with cards you find. Learn your robot's movement cards by practicing with them. Give them a try and see what each card does. Once you know how to use them you can plan and try to dodge enemies as you make your way to the exit. HOW TO PLAY: You click and drag cards into whatever order you want. Then when you're ready, hit the play button and watch your robot follow the commands on the cards. You can add cards to modify your robot's moves. There are numerous different stages to explore along with dozens of special moves to discover. The game features at least 2+ hours of gameplay. *Please note that the game may have some bugs as it is a prototype. We'll try to squash anything nasty we come across.

rows.name: Introvert: A Teenager Simulator
rows.short_description: One of the new guys in school tells you he’s going to shoot up the school if he doesn’t make friends in 5 days. Discover the decisions, people, situations you will encounter while playing and trying to make friends of your own and living your own life.
rows.description_html: WISHLIST! About the Game WARNING: This game contains heavy material that might make players/audience uncomfortable. In Introvert: A Teenager Simulator, one of the new guys in school tells you he’s going to shoot up the school if he doesn’t make friends in 5 days. Discover the decisions, people, situations you will encounter while playing with the other new guy in school trying to make friends of your own and living your own life. This game talks about serious issues such as bullying and suicidal thoughts in a new and different way that will hopefully be interpreted better by the new generation. In this game. This project is also personal to me. It is a small universe I created to make my zone-out thoughts and stories a reality. I made this game cause I was sad so it took a while to be finished, cause you know… It’s hard to work on something when you’re sad. Story: It’s the first day of school in Happyville. You are a mute, one of the two new kids in the kids in the school. The other new guy is Chris, an introvert quiet guy, who tells you he will shoot up the school if he doesn’t make a friend in 5 days. Yes, you can be his friend to fix all this, but instead you can take out his crush who’s made sure you know she’s interested in you, or maybe you can go out with his bullies who are planning to break into the school tomorrow to change their test marks. You have 5 days to make those decisions. Features: - Entertaining but suspenseful gameplay - Multiple endings - Fully voiced characters - Dank and glitched-out universe - Gen Z humor - Lots of Lo-fi - Unique graphics and visuals - Captivating interesting characters - Narrative-driven story - Immersive lore - Can be played with only a keyboard - Available for Windows, Mac, Linux - A turtle in the school Gameplay: In this weird game, for 5 days, you go to school then hang out after. Lots of decisions to be made and they all affect the gameplay and ending. The town is full of secrets and places ready to be explored. Pretty simple. About me: I am Faris, one of the Euphoric Brothers. Addicted to overthinking, lo-fi, and making video games, I decided to merge all three hobbies into one project, thus, Introvert: A Teenager Simulator was born. I have developed this game completely by myself except for some audio, songs and the voice acting. Oh, and I am also 19 and a first-year university student. After releasing a lot of failed commercial games, I realized that I don’t care about money and that what I really want is to create my own universe and community :)

rows.name: flaming/million
rows.short_description: A NEW RPG FOUND IN THIS FLAMING DUMPSTER: undo this curse of toxic masculinity upon yr college campus through the power of glitches
rows.description_html: A NEW GAME FOUND IN THIS FLAMING DUMPSTER: follow L.C. through a warped gltich campus during the FRATPARADE. destroy the three (3) police surveillance monuments and rid the campus of masculine oppression. use the queer power of glitches and begin to heal this terrible curse put on us all. 40 - 60 minutes of gameplay Combining JRPG poetry, my haunted dreams of the SUNY Oswego campus and its infamous local holiday 'Bridge Street Run,' the tensions of the Covid-19 pandemic, and everything I had learned about glitch/corruption processes up to that point, the game follows a sort of glitch goddess as she uses the glitches developed by her queer community/friends to undo the curses of toxic masculinity around her campus (in the form of alt-right graffiti, overzealous police officers and their monuments, a gay bar turned into a straight bar [based on a true story], etc). *flaming/million does currently not support Steam overlay!*

rows.name: Ascension: Transition and Silver
rows.short_description: Ascension is a visual novel following three lost souls as they venture into The Zone - a dangerous and alien world. Follow the abrasive Doctor, the shy Scholar and sardonic Escort on their journey - though none of them will come out unscathed.
rows.description_html: A Hostile World Ascension: Transition and Silver is a LGBT+ visual novel following three lost souls as they venture into The Zone - a dangerous and alien area, fenced off by the rest of the world - and at its center is rumoured to be something that can grant any wish, any innermost desire. But, at a price. There's no turning back. Once you leave your old life behind to go chasing dreams, you can never return. Two desperate people and their sardonic guide venture into The Zone, but what they find there will forever, permanently change them - and, just maybe, change the world. This game is about being broken and queer and gender-damaged in a world that will never accept you - but still holding out hope for one last chance to fix everything. Features - Ascension: Transition and Silver is a 2 - 3 hour visual novel - Multiple choices and five endings - Ascension: Transition and Silver is currently available for Windows, Mac and Linux (Mac version available at ) Content Warning: The game contains strong language, references to drug and tobacco use, body horror, and themes of sexuality and gender dysphoria About the Creators A game by SulMatul, music by Kyle Merckx, Zoe Blade and Priroda, art by Joanna Estep and Anon, banner art by Mayorhead Editing by Matt Cox​, William Harke, RagnarRox​, Jade Bacalso, and Codex Entry​

rows.name: Stories of Liane
rows.short_description: An experimental narrative-focused walking-simulator experience that explores dark settings and stories through multiple perspectives.
rows.description_html: 300 years into the future: Earth is uninhabitable. Only the most powerful have escaped searching for a new home for humanity. Stories of Liane is an experimental experience that explores the narrative and visuals of a dark dystopian atmosphere through multiple different perspectives and settings. This is a collection of stories from several characters to explore humanity's future in this dark future. Chapter One (Releasing March 2021): A private investigator is sent to investigate why a corporate vessel crashed on an uncharted planet. She later realizes the disappearance and crash may have been more sinister than initially believed. Chapter Two (Releasing Fall 2021): Yet to be released Chapter Three (Release Date TBD): Yet to be released

rows.name: Loneliness
rows.short_description: An experimental, minimalistic microgame about loneliness. Originally released as a Flash game in 2010 that was featured by Extra Credits.
rows.description_html: An experimental, minimalistic art game that explores a single emotion and takes only a few minutes to play through. Loneliness is a simple top-down exploration game where the only available input is movement. Explore a flat landscape populated by other squares that engage in various social behaviors represented metaphorically through patterns of their own simple movement. Loneliness was originally released as a Flash game in 2010. It was featured prominently by Extra Credits (Season 4, Episode 3: Mechanics as Metaphor) and others, and received a variety of accolades, including being nominated for the Extra Credits Innovation Awards. Other people said the game was the worst thing they'd ever played--but at least it wasn't on Steam. This is a 10th anniversary release that is true to the original game, except that the end screen has been notably removed, as described at the game's home page. The original version of the game is available on Steam as part of The Gametrekking Omnibus. Credits: Game by Jordan Magnuson Music by Kevin MacLeod

rows.reviews_html: “Affected me the first time, and even more strongly the second.” Gregory Weir (creator of Necropolis and The Majesty of Colors) “What’s amazing about it is that it undeniably has a narrative, even though it features no words… but what’s more incredible to me is how different that narrative can be for different people… This game not only tries to put us in the emotional state of that crushing loneliness… but it lets us explore it, and this to me is the unique power games have.” Extra Credits (Season 4, Episode 3: Mechanics as Metaphor) “Ye gods, it’s not emo sixth form poetry these days is it, it’s dreadful indie games” @kateri_t on Twitter

rows.name: Carotic - Academic Version
rows.short_description: Carotic is a top-down 3D couch-co-op hide-and-seek game for 2-4 players. Each player plays the role of a car in a very busy city. Their task is to drive like the other NPC cars while trying to identify the other players. In order to gain points the other players must be destroyed by dashing into them.
rows.description_html: Carotic is a top-down 3D couch-co-op hide-and-seek game for 2-4 players. Each player plays the role of a car in a very busy city. Their task is to drive like the other NPC cars while trying to identify the other players. In order to gain points the other players must be destroyed by dashing into them. The player with the most points after a set amount of time wins. HIDE AND SEEK This is just the core gameplay of Carotic as described above. The players' goal is to find the other competitors and dash into them resulting in points for this player and destruction with a short respawn timer for the other. Dashing NPCs does not penalize the player apart from revealing them because of the particle effect and speed up that they gain. REACH THE GOALS In addition to the normal game mechanics there are circles of particles that spawn randomly on the map. Players can drive through them to gain additional points providing a common incentive for the players to group up on one point which allows for more options to destroy the other players. DESTROY THE TOWN Evolved from a previous idea – the chaos mode – in which all buildings on the map were destructible. Similar to the REACH THE GOALS game mode this one has the additional quirk that there is always one random building which can be destroyed by dashing into it. Destroying buildings is rewarded with points which again, creates a common incentive for the players to group up around a key point on the map. KRAKATTACK If you can’t guess it from the title of the game mode, KRAKATTACK features a kraken which is attacking the town. The players can dash into its tentacles to make them retreat into the water. The monster will also destroy players if it slams on them. There is also lightning and thunder that will strike the ground randomly and if a player is too close to the point where the lightning struck, they will get destroyed. FREE FOR ALL RACE Is completely different from the other game modes. Players race against each other on a different map - no hiding, no seeking, just racing. In addition to the dash, the players can select events which they can trigger to gain an advantage over the other players. They can destroy buildings to create shortcuts, let a bus drive and destroy all cars in its way, drop a crate from a crane and spawn a boat that jumps onto the street to destroy everything in its way and more!

rows.short_description: It is man-made that a city happened an confused accident in a sudden? Whether the unknown thing existed in the darkest of the world. Superpower, monster, magic may be right by our side. In the dark, the ‘monsters’ from the different world, organized to investigate the unknowns.
rows.description_html: Do you believe that in the city where you live, in those dark places, beside you, there are things that break common sense? It is man-made that a city happened an confused accident in a sudden? Whether the unknown thing existed in the darkest of the world. Superpower, monster, magic may be right by our side. In the dark, the ‘monsters’ from the different world, organized to investigate the unknowns. ——————————Introduction to the game—————————— Look at the screenshot can know, this is a horizontal version of 2D fighting game. But strictly speaking, it can't be regarded as an action fighting game. After all, there are so few animation. The difficulty of the game is divided into three modes: easy, normal and hard, and it is also divided into plot mode and no plot mode, with a total of six play modes. Developer's recommendation: [/] If you only want to watch the plot, you can choose easy plot mode to play. Just want to play the game of optional normal no plot mode to play. Want to challenge the optional hard no plot mode to play. It's better to follow the advice. After all, you can't skip the plot. If you put yourself at risk to choose the hard mode, some of the testers will called you daddy. Game features: [/] The author plays fewer games, so I don't know what features can be said. Here are some unique ones ——Three way attack: they are 'up', 'middle' and 'down'. The W and s keys can adjust the attack direction. ——Tired death mechanism: in addition to movement and stillness and triggering, the object controlled by the player will consume physical strength no matter what he does. If the physical strength is exhausted, he can continue to play, but will let his health replace his physical strength. ——Somersault mechanism: This is an unintentional feature / bug. The combination of Ctrl roll and space jump can form a 'somersault' action. The rest of the mechanisms are not unique, such as the property panel. I won't list them here. ——————————characters introduce—————————— ——————————Q & A—————————— Q: The store display supports English. Why is it still Chinese after entering the game? A: Click option in the lower right corner to find the '语言' option and switch to English.

rows.name: A Knights Adventure
rows.short_description: A Knights Adventure is an action packed medieval adventure game. The brave knight must fight his way through different realms. The player can acquire the help of companions or mercenaries through out his adventure.
rows.description_html: A Knights Adventure is an action packed adventure game in a medieval setting. On this adventure the brave knight must fight his way through the different realms. The knight can acquire the help of companions though gaining their trust or buy the help of mercenaries through the weight of his coin. Companions will fight harder and stay by your side no matter what, even if it means dying at your side. Mercenaries on the other hand will leave your service if your coin purse becomes a little too light for their liking.

rows.name: Infinite Dungeon Crawler
rows.short_description: Fantasy turn-based RPG. Build and customize your party with 8 character classes and lots of weapons and armor options. Explore and fight through randomly generated worlds in search of loot with over 45 monster types to battle. Lots of skills, abilities, and magik spells provide ample re-playability.
rows.description_html: Fortune-hunters of all sorts are flocking to the town of Evervale, where the mysterious “Gate” has been discovered. This mystifying portal transports adventurers to strange new worlds filled with precious loot and monsters. Create your character and bring on hirelings to join your expeditions. Make your character look how you want Choose gender, facial features, hairstyle, skin tone, height and body size 6 different character races (Human, Dwarf, Half-Goblin, Common Elf, Dark Elf, Golden Elf) Fight and play your way 8 character classes to choose from (Fighter, Mage, Paladin, Rogue, Cleric, Ranger, Druid, and Alchemist) Specialize in one-handed melee weapons, ranged weapons like bows, use a staff of fire … choose your own style and mix your party to be effective Slot attributes (e.g., Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Charisma, and Fortitude) and gain skills and abilities as you level up Over 50 weapon types: Scimitars, Bastard Swords, Crossbows, Maces, Hammers, and more Over 100 different armor types: Plates, Leathers, Boots, Gloves, Helmets, Greaves, and more Exciting Turn-Based Combat 45 different monster types: Goblins, Skeletons, Harpies, Bugbears, Spiders, Rats, Ghouls, Will-o-Wisps, plus more Over 120 spells and abilities to choose from for your characters: Burning Hands, Ice Knife, Sleep, Heal Others, Fairy Fire, Divine Light, Precision Strike, Smoke Bomb, Hail of Thorns, and more Randomly generated worlds so you never know what to expect during your adventures Free to play version allows full game but limits character progression beyond level 4 (think of this more like a never-ending demo) No ads or annoying in-app purchases to progress (you only pay once to unlock the base game content) Additional worlds available through purchased DLC’s, with new monsters and additional weapons, armors, and abilities Please note that the game is Java-based, so requires Java to be installed on your computer. The game should prompt you to download from Oracle if you don't already have it installed.

rows.name: SNS
rows.short_description: SNS is a Biopunk table top roleplaying game. On an alternate future earth, after a horrific calamity knocks technological progress into a tailspin, the world is wholly entrenched in a snowy hellscape with Biotechnology at the forefront of the battle against the elements.
rows.description_html: This is an early access game and will continue to be updated. Step into a world where flesh transcends metal, and biotechnology reigns supreme. Synesthesia Synthetica is a Biopunk table top roleplaying game built for digital and real life play. On an alternate future earth, after a horrific calamity knocks technological progress into a tailspin, the world is wholly entrenched in a snowy hellscape with Biotechnology at the forefront of the battle against the elements. Flesh replaces metal, bones line the interior. Rainfall patters on endless snow. Neon plastic jackets glow, blood vibrant against the white expanse.  In SNS, you craft your journey by choosing from 14 archetypes, split into 4 types, roles that define your skills, playstyle, and identity. Whether you soar as a daring Cloudkin, command loyalty as a Hivehead, or manipulate the masses as a Charlatan, each archetype offers unique abilities and challenges. Voyagers: Navigate skies and seas, exploring the unknown. Lawbreakers: Rule the frozen underworld with wit and force. Aristocrats: Wield influence to reshape society. Specialists: Innovate and heal in a world driven by biotech. Your genotype, a genetic blueprint of evolution, further shapes your character. Choose to wield the fiery tenacity of the Hellion, the eerie intellect of a Cognitive, or the sheer resilience of a Syllabub. These enhancements entwine your identity with the world’s chilling demands and remarkable possibilities. What you get with this application An interactive saveable and shareable tabletop character builder for the tabletop game Synethesia Synthetica, aka SNS. an ingame audio-player supplied with custom SNS themed music tracks Access to all future content free of charge, meaning DLC, Extra characters, New maps and any other planned content.

rows.name: HARD TAPES
rows.short_description: First person shooter Psychological horror, which is about sick thought experiments that will be seen thanks to some videotapes and demonstrate what dark is the world now.
rows.description_html: Do you deal with toxic people every day?... Well, you are not the only one. In this little game the characters will be those people who treat you like garbage at work in the family and on the street and even at parties and the list goes on. You will make the decision whether to forgive those bad people who do not value others or value their luck. First person shooter Psychological horror, where you will find traps, monsters, normal people and weapons, The game will be varied, you will not feel anything repetitive, there will be moments where fighting will be an option and others where running will be the only option, The villain Bill will be in charge of teaching you the tutorial and will tell you the description and history of each character.

rows.name: Lilith Was Dead
rows.short_description: After being away at college, you meet up with two of your friends at a local movie theatre. What starts out as a simple reunion, quickly unravels to be a gruesome murder mystery with your friend as the victim. It is now your mission to find out who did it, and how in this visual novel style game.
rows.description_html: Lilith Was Dead is a murder mystery visual novel where you must solve the murder. You take on the role of a detective by taking notes (in real life!), deducing, and using your wits to find out who killed Lilith! This game features many choices throughout (in the usual visual novel format) which can result in alternate paths and endings depending on the decisions you make. You must make your decisions wisely as some wrong choices may even result in you falling victim to murder! This game has an average runtime of around 1.5 - 2 hours long. ABOUT THE DEVELOPERS This is the first game ever to be developed and published by Heat Wave Games! Our first video game, Lilith Was Dead, was initially created for a college project. However, during the creation process, our passion for game-making and storytelling couldn't just end there. So, we decided to found the company 'Heat Wave Games' on December 1, 2020, so we could not only continue to make more games but do it at an even higher level. Now, we have a competent team of individuals whose combined strengths have the ability to produce amazing new game titles! As a new indie game company, we hope to grow with the help of the dedicated players within the ever-growing gaming community!

rows.name: Jetscout: Boot Camp
rows.short_description: Boost and flip through 3 unique missions of various difficulties with a jetpack before your first real mission in the game Jetscout: Mystery of the Valunians!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Jetscout: Boot Camp , a completely free jetpack-based platformer featuring the Jetscout Essential Training Simulation (JETS) for all new Jetscout recruits! Boost and flip through 3 unique missions, dodging deadly spikes, plants, lasers and more to master the basics of Jetscout flight! When you're ready, you can tackle your first real mission of exploring a distant solar system and uncovering the secrets behind the strange Valunian race in the game Jetscout: Mystery of the Valunians.

rows.name: Fear Surrounds
rows.short_description: Fear Surrounds is a horror-tinged take on the werewolf-style social subterfuge genre, where two evil spirits hide within a group of players and attempt to sabotage and murder them.
rows.description_html: DISCUSSION About the Game Overview Fear Surrounds is a horror-themed 3D Werewolf game. Specters hide among a group of good guys who need to root out the specters' true identities asap. The game has dozens of professions and maps, making for a diverse experience that never gets old. Plus there are fun modes like Battle Royale. How to Play Players play as either specters or good guys and must determine who the killers are through behavior and speaking in meetings. Good guys must constantly watch over the actions of those around them. During meetings, they must clearly describe their whereabouts, who they suspect and why. But don't trust the words of others lightly, and don't make rash conclusions based on conjecture. If you're wrong, your team will be at a disadvantage. Clergy have a broader field of view and must use their skills to lead the good team to victory. Specters need to kill all of the good guys without getting caught. They can communicate with teammates with voice messages, use skills to cover each other, and kill good guys or create alibis among chaos. They need to lie about their whereabouts during meetings, accuse others or even pretend to be Clergy. Their goal is to interfere with the good team's judgment as much as possible. Player Objectives Good Faction 1. Complete all quests to achieve victory. 2. Vote out all specters during meetings to achieve victory. (Analyze the behavior and speech of other players to determine if they are good or bad. If you make the wrong choice, someone innocent may die because of it.) Specters Faction 1. Pretend to be good. Kill good guys when there are no eyewitnesses. 2. Use destruction skills to create an opportunity to kill. 3. Lie during meetings to influence the votes. 4. Kill all good guys to achieve victory. Profession Details Good Faction Professions: 1. Traveler: must continuously complete quests to avoid losing HP and dying. Has no special abilities. Clergy: travelers with special abilities. Like regular travelers, they also continuously lose HP. 1. Priest: can verify someone's faction, but doesn't know their specific identity. 2. White Spirit: can assassinate one person once per game. 3. Avenger: when sacrificed, will kill the target who voted him/her out. 4. Forensic Doctor: can see all corpses on the map. 5. Idiot: will not be killed the first time they are sacrificed, but can no longer vote or speak in meetings afterwards. 6. Psychic: at each meeting, learns which faction the dead belong to. Specter Professions: have the ability to assassinate and destroy by default. 1. Nightmare: can blind all players. 2. Magic Eye: can see the location of all players. 3. Ghost King: has an extra assassination ability, but dies after using it. 4. Ghost Priest: can verify the identity of a corpse. 5. Hidden Demon: before awakening, cannot be detected by the Priest or Pope's skills. 6. Silence Specter: can silence 1 player during each round of the game. 7. Betrayer: has the abilities of a regular traveler, and neither specters nor travelers know his identity. Has to help the specters win. Map Details There are many maps including hospital, school and prison. Each map offers unique scenario that players must solve in combination with the jobs. Use CTRL to view the map and Tab to display nearby quests. New players can use the training mode to get familiar with the maps. FAQ If there is no reaction when you click the 'PLAY' button on the steam page, you need open the game installation directory to find the 'c++ Repair tool' to repair the 'DirectX' environment.

rows.name: Remember When
rows.short_description: The story follows a phone call between Noah and his wife, Sarah as they recall pivotal moments in their relationship. Peer into Noah's memories and relive the couple's happiest moments through choice based dialogue, a unique art-style, and an original soundtrack in this fully voice acted experience.
rows.description_html: DEVELOPER'S NOTE It is highly recommended to play this game using a 120hz and below monitor. 'Remember When' is an interactive Narrative Experience meant to be experienced in a single sitting and it takes roughly 30 minutes . STORY The story follows a phone call between Noah and his wife, Sarah as they recall pivotal moments in their relationship. Peer into Noah's memories and relive the couple's happiest moments together through choice based dialogue , a unique art-style , and an original soundtrack in this fully voice acted experience. CONTROLS Mouse : Click to move Interact Make dialogue choices ESC : Return to the Main Menu / Exit the Game

rows.name: Raging Ball
rows.short_description: First finish the game, then improve your speed.
rows.description_html: RAGING BALL You're a ball and all you have to do is to finish the run. The controls are easy but the levels can seem difficult. Sometimes... Well, sometimes you gonna rage. There are 30 levels dispatch on 3 chapters. ADVICES All level can be finished ; You can train with the training mode (in the chapters selections) ; If you loose to much, take a good breath ; Some level are still difficult to me ; Every 'S' notes had already been acheived by myself (so it's possible!) ; Send me your best score. NOTES During the game, you gonna have some notes : Levels notes depend on the time spent ; Chapters notes depend on the levels notes (not on the time spent). HISTORY This is my first game. I learned code and Unity with RagingBall. If you like this I will make other runs... But to be fair, you gonna hate this game.

rows.name: Goblin Dungeoneer
rows.short_description: Prepare for 'Hell in Video Game Form' in this brutal, tough as nails, retro, platforming-adventure game! Save your starving tribe by collecting riches within a spike filled dungeon!
rows.description_html: THE DUNGEON AWAITS: Prepare for ' hell in video game form '! Goblin Dungeoneer is a tough as nails platforming game developed by CrackedGhostGames. Traverse through 50 unique levels, leap over dangerous spike pits, dodge dangerous arrow traps, and much more! Enter the dungeon to save your starving goblin tribe! You are going to die... A lot... What kind of dungeon would this be if it wasn't dangerous? Also, coyote time is for COWARDS! IMAGINE JUMPING ON AIR! Good luck, kid. Goblin Dungeoneer is a PRECISION PLATFORMER! You are going to need PRECISE movement to succeed! FEATURES: 50 Unique Levels! 5 Worlds! A bangin' soundtrack! Challenge Modes! Secrets!

rows.name: Dysterra
rows.short_description: On a future post-apocalyptic Earth, build, craft, and loot other players’ bases to survive long enough to board the rocket and escape the dangerous robots and mercenaries that inhabit Ararat Island. Manipulate the weather and use earthquakes to change when the server wipe occurs in DYSTERRA!
rows.description_html: Join Our Community About the Game Our FPS Sci-fi survival crafting PvP game is set on a post-apocalyptic Earth where humanity has been forced to live off-planet on a giant satellite named Orbis. You have been sent down to Earth to gather a mineral called Terrasite that is now humanity’s main source of energy. In Dysterra, you must gather materials, build your base, craft weapons and items, and gather terrasite to power your base. Work together with other players to build a giant stronghold, or go solo and hunt down other players to work your way to the top of the rankings! Unique Modes: - Single Player (offline) - PvP Servers (online only, requires Founder's Pack) - PvE Multiplayer Servers (online only, requires Founder's Pack) - Custom Servers (online only) Control When Wipes Occur! rows.description_html: Play my New Game! - CONQUER HUMANITY About the Game Join our Community here Physics Based Battles. Filled with funny ragdoll moments and dismemberments that you rarely see in games! Fight in Big Brawls. Simulate large battles in teams or free for all, why not trying a 1 v 50! Use the Environment and Traps. Grab and Push opponents on traps or use your swings and momentum to deliver lethal hits! Fight Bosses and Unique Enemies. It's not just about spamming attacks... be tactical, dodge and catch your enemies off-guard! WARNING: You thought you were good at games ? Think twice, this is actually difficult. If you're skilled, you can execute in one hit and so can your opponents as-well. Misjudging a fight or not reacting fast enough can result in your head spinning away from your body, losing the Glory you've collected and starting all over again.

rows.name: Gas Station Simulator: Prologue - Early Days
rows.short_description: The 'Early Days' prologue to Gas Station Simulator where you buy an abandoned gas station in the middle of nowhere, fix it up and start running it.
rows.description_html: CHECK OUT THE FULL GAME About the Game Gas Station Simulator is all about renovating, expanding and running a gas station along a highway in the middle of nowhere USA. This prologue to the game serves as an introduction to the beginnings of it all, where you find an abandoned gas station, buy it and start renovating it in order to be able to service your first customers. That's why we call the prologue 'Early Days'. You acquire the gas station is a pretty rundown state. It has been exposed to the elements for years and you will need to put some serious work into it in order to restore it to a useful state. You will have to clear the area of sand and rubble, fix the place up and take care of the inside as well. There are plenty of tools at your disposal to renovate the place and bring it to a state that won’t repeal customers by how it looks. The renovation itself is just part of the job, you will also have to keep in clean and tidy. Once you fixed the place up a little bit, you can think about customizing it and adding some personal touches. The prologue offers some of the customization features of the full game to give you a solid idea what types of customizations you can look forward to. Both the outside and inside of the gas station are covered giving you a solid idea of what to look forward to. You have spend all the money you had to buy the gas station and had to borrow some cash on top of that. Restoring the gas station to its former glory will cost you a bit, too. Hence any money that comes in becomes crucial. Thankfully you don’t need to wait for the gas station to be fully restored to start earning some money. Some fuel, fixing up the gas pump and you can start serving the occasional customer already. While you can’t offer your customers much else at this point, it’s a start toward a full fledged gas station offering lots of different services.

rows.name: The Legend of Karl
rows.short_description: The Legend of Karl is a 2.5D hack and slash platformer. You'll master various weapons while exploring the deep diabolical world. A quest struggling between Good and Evil, fight for Justice and what you Believe!
rows.description_html: Story In a parallel universe, there are numerous worlds exist, live and die on their own space and time. They have their own stories and histories, some think they are all on their own, some wonder what are there beyond their limits. There are two worlds, the Spirit and the Human, are experiencing something more in this parallel universe. These two worlds are in fact affecting each other, reflecting each other with every move and happenings even though they do not know the existence of one another. Once in a while, in a certain point of moment in time, these two worlds collide and become one ... A world of Mystery Power Struggle Survival Fight Love Redemption The clans of Spirit take rule over the world, yet the clans themselves fight for the ultimate rulership over the whole world by gaining power from the Balance. They need to open the secret gate of the Balance through the Soul Stone to gain the power. Human is the only living thing to be able to get close to the gate without being diminished and Human is the only source to keep the gate “alive”. Karl, one of the few human left on world after the Great Collide, trying hard to search for his sister who is believed captured by the clan of spirits. The secret alliance, struggles between good and evil, to be dead or alive, power and riddles, lost and redemption… awaiting there, gazing at your presence. The Quest and Fight begin. Game Features Classic 2D platformer with 3D art style. Hack and slash action focused combat system. Wide range of weapons unlocked as you defeat the ferocious enemies. Explore the World which is full of demonic nature and forgotten dungeons. A demonic, powerful “companion” whom lead and temp your journey. Is it a friend or a foe, or neither? Power is a dangerous word.

rows.name: Prison Wars
rows.short_description: Prison Wars is a well known classic that will let you experience the harsh life inside a maximum security prison. Earn some quick cash, smuggle items and get as much respect as you can from fellow inmates. Make sure you join a gang, take control of the prison and watch your back!
rows.description_html: Prison Wars is an old-school browser based PvP MMORPG. A loved and well established classic, with the original version still running and having a dedicated active community! This is a remake of that same beloved game, by the same people who created the original! Features We've remade the entire UI from scratch, to include long requested changes and updates. Added 16:9 support and improved textures. Recalibrated balancing. Remade and introduced new game features. While we've left all the features you know and love Prison Wars for: PvP - Fight all other inmates to see who comes on top! Gangs - Create or join a prison guild with other players. Gang Activities - Co-op with your gang mates and take on jobs together. Gang Wars - Take over prison territories in epic gang wars! Prison Control - Take over enough territories and the guards, and rule them all! Character development - Increase stats the way you want to. Skills - Decide what illicit trades you want to focus on. Global and Local chat functionality - communication is key.

Bring a friend to the carnage, either side by side in local Co-Op or in the safety of each other's home using Remote Play Together! A manor soon to be in shambles! The inhabitants are very tidy and everything in their home is waiting to be tempered with! Examine, experiment on and destroy every object in the house! With your ghostly powers, cause mayhem and ruin the lives, and deaths, of the inhabitants. Uncover the family's secret There's something familiar about this mansion, but what could it be? Through destruction, find out everything about this family and anything they could be hiding.

rows.name: Knight Squad 2 Trials
rows.short_description: Triumph over friends in this chaotic arcade battle royale game for up to 8 players. Jump online, grab a sword, load your bazooka, and be the last knight standing in this free-to-play version of Knight Squad 2.
rows.description_html: Check the full game About the Game Knight Squad 2 heralds the return of a beloved multiplayer experience anyone can play and enjoy. The mechanics are simple enough for any peasant: move around the field, swing your sword, block enemy attacks, grab a bazooka, mount a unicorn, annihilate your rivals and become the champion! Knight Squad 2 Trials allows cavaliers to create Battle Royale lobbies and join lobbies created by other men-at-arms, therefore gaining access to the full content of the game. The full version of Knight Squad 2 includes 13 game modes, 8 additional unlockable knights, and 97 battle arenas. Online multiplayer Duke it out with friends or challenge competitors worldwide in online lobbies. Access to all the content Through the lobbies created by other players, Knight Squad 2 Trials players can experience all of the game modes and maps in the full game. 8 player madness Whether allies are around or not, matches can always be filled with customizable and challenging AI opponents. Extremely easy to learn Choose a classic controller or go for our intuitive keyboard and mouse controls. Wacky weaponry Wield weapons from the middle ages, such as the noble bow, the exotic boomerang, or sneaky proximity mines! Customizable gameplay Turn up the chaos by greasing up the floor, enabling exploding corpses, or mixing up the starter weapons and upgrades.

rows.description_html: Ulna Online is a free multiplayer electronic game (MMORPG) developed by Moscano. It started to be created in 2017. In it, players can develop the skills of their characters, search for treasures, solve puzzles and explore areas such as cities, dungeons, forests, deserts, islands, beaches, mines, etc. The characters can fight fights with each other or with creatures, such as monsters, dragons, demons, using weapons and spells. When starting the game, your avatar starts on the island of Corbie, an island where every player must pass until he develops skills necessary for progress and survival on the other maps in the game. When the player reaches Corbie's last map, he can optionally choose his vocation and leave the island. In Cayman, the player becomes familiar with the game and learns many things about the world of Ulna Online, such as magic, equipment and etc.

rows.description_html: [Game Intro] The originator of auto battler - Auto Chess! The Dota Auto Chess, which has been sweeping over the world since 2019, released its indie game! Auto Chess, introduced by Drodo Studio and Dragonest Co.Ltd., is an original auto battler game that inherits the strategic gameplay of Dota Auto Chess. Fight in an 8-way match, pondering on the features of various lineups made up of 22 races and 13 classes! Let's play chess in leisure time! -Innovative Gameplay By collecting/changing Hero cards, and arranging different formations, 8 chess gamers will be contending for the first prize in the following tens of minutes. Millions of players are challenging each other every day, and it has become one of the most popular leisure gameplays nowadays. -Strategy Rules the World Players will randomly get their Heroes in the Sharing Cardpool, and form special formations according to their unique strategies. Evolution, combination, jockey for position, etc. enable you to practice your strategies to the greatest extent. Who will be adaptable to the changing tide and survive till the end? -Fair Play Make a real fair-play game! The World e-Sports Games are created by Dragonest Co.Ltd., Drodo, and lmbaTV. -Global Server No matter where you come from, welcome to our world and challenge players from all over the world!

Features Various Upgrades: Generate three different resources more efficiently! Attractive Skills: The three cute characters have various attractive skills! Spend resources on them to be more strong! You can put any skill in the skill slot and build your own skill set! Vast Explorable Areas: Journey through the world and encounter all kinds of monsters that will do all that they can to end you quickly. rows.name: Sixth Extinction
rows.short_description: Sixth extinction is a dark, narrative-driven experience about extinction and discovering the true nature of yourself. Can you outwit the obstacles in your way, uncover the truth and begin a change?
rows.description_html: One of the most original games Sixth Extinction is not your average puzzle game. With a dark and hard-hitting story lurking beneath the gameplay, it's up to you to uncover the truth and play your way to an important revelation about both yourself and the world you live in. Discover your true nature: learn what your choice say about you, and open your mind to a positive change. Think outside the box: use your intellect to conquer the obstacles in your way, and discover the game's deep message. Short but thought-provoking: immerse yourself in an hour-long, atmospheric experience. Made with love: from the hand-drawn visuals to the poetic narration, every moment has been crafted to enhance your enjoyment. A dark message: the story of this game contains heavy themes of extinction, revenge and violence. An adult audience is recommended.

rows.name: Paper Glider
rows.short_description: Paper Glider is a construction-paper-styled game in which you control a gliding paper triangle through a series of 70 colorful levels. The controls are simple but difficult to master, leading to a challenging and rewarding gameplay experience. Learn to master your momentum to complete all 7 worlds!
rows.description_html: Paper Glider is a construction-paper-styled game in which you control a gliding paper triangle through a series of 70 colorful levels. The controls are simple but difficult to master, leading to a challenging and rewarding gameplay experience. Learn to master your momentum to complete all 7 worlds! The goal is simple: reach the end of each level. As you progress through Paper Glider's 7 worlds, this task becomes increasingly difficult. From avoiding objects with gravitational pulls and dodging past projectiles, to teleporting around levels and cloning yourself, there are many different challenges and features to discover on your journey to complete each world! Along with 70 unique levels to play through, you are also able to view various stats about your gameplay. Find out how many times you have died on each level and how long it took you to beat them. Track your fastest times or your slowest, and which levels you have died on the most. There are all kinds of statistics to see!

The game is early acces so many features like campaign and such are not present.

rows.name: Curatours
rows.short_description: Curatours provides up close, personal access to cultural exhibitions within the safety and convenience of your own virtual space. Designed from the ground up to be as accessible to as many audiences as possible, unlocking real-world content that may have previously been out of reach.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Curatours! Curatours is a social tour platform for culture and heritage. Visit incredible places filled with art, artefacts, stories and friends. Visitors can access tours of museums around the world from desktop, phones or VR headsets. In VR it's an incredibly immersive experience and on other devices it feels like a cross between a video call and playing a multiplayer game. Curatours is free to download and offers three types of cultural tour: Self-Guided Start a solo tour and explore the experiences at your own pace with this self-guided option. Private Tour Start or join a private online tour, using a private room code to keep you in control of who can join your tour group. Public Tour Jump in to an online public tour to share and explore together with other members of the public. Virtual Spaces for Culture, Museums and Galleries Curatours offers visitors a wide range of interactive experiences, from local museums to cultural and historic exhibitions. The virtual spaces allow visitors to get up close and personal with animals, artworks, and artefacts in ways not possible in the real world, all from the comfort of their own homes! Download Curatours for free today and experience: Bradford District Museum and Galleries The Bradford District is home to some of the most exciting museums and galleries in the UK. We are thrilled to host a pilot exhibit, leading to a programme of work celebrating Bradford as the 2025 City of Culture 2025. Uncover strange stone markings amongst the ancient neolithic moors Get up close and personal with a historic haunted night in Bolling Hall Explore the Belle Vue photography studio, where local Bradford people were immortalised in film between 1902 and 1975 Museum of Colour Too often we ignore the many achievements of the generations that came before us. The ‘Respect Due’ project aims to capture as many of these unique perspectives as possible, showcasing a selection of individuals through art, audio interviews and personal artefacts. Curatours is proud to offer a permanent virtual home for the exhibit, and showcase an exciting step for the Museum of Colour in their mission to open up new avenues for accessibility, inclusivity, and the preservation of cultural heritage in an increasingly digital world. Museum of Plastic 2121 Visit a future where single use plastics are only ever found in museums. Museum of Plastic 2121 is an imagined future museum, built to teach future generations about plastics and tell the story of how activism started in 2021 led to the positive change that resulted in us cleaning up our oceans and forever changing our relationship with plastic. Taking inspiration from the Solarpunk movement, Curatours worked closely with South African activists Greenpop and Baz-Art , utlising some of their real world murals and 3D paintings. Built 100 years from now in an imagined future where things have worked out well for both the planet and humanity, the exhibit is perfectly at home on the Curatours platform which isn’t constrained by time or space. and more!

rows.name: Veneficium
rows.short_description: 𝘚𝘵𝘢𝘺 𝘲𝘶𝘪𝘦𝘵. 𝘚𝘵𝘢𝘺 𝘩𝘪𝘥𝘥𝘦𝘯. 𝘞𝘢𝘵𝘤𝘩 𝘺𝘰𝘶𝘳 𝘴𝘵𝘦𝘱𝘴. 𝘐𝘧 𝘺𝘰𝘶 𝘥𝘰𝘯'𝘵, 𝘙𝘶𝘯. Play as Abigail in her quest to find her grandmother in a cursed forest. Use your spellcasting abilities to hide from various dangers. Will you survive the night?
rows.description_html: Being on your guard will become second nature in Veneficium, a survival-horror game developed by a passionate team. Play as Abigail Vandran, a witch who has only one goal in mind: to find her grandmother Willow and escape a forest of death... Only if she survives the wrath of the demons lurking in the mist. ⛧ 𝘐𝘮𝘮𝘦𝘳𝘴𝘪𝘷𝘦 𝘌𝘹𝘱𝘦𝘳𝘪𝘦𝘯𝘤𝘦: Explore a realistic environment set deep in the woods, filled with hair-raising sounds that are sure to hold you spellbound. ⛧ 𝘚𝘵𝘦𝘢𝘭𝘵𝘩: Be careful where you step and use your environment to your advantage in escaping unpredictable enemies, or it may cost you your life. ⛧ 𝘎𝘭𝘰𝘰𝘮𝘺 𝘈𝘵𝘮𝘰𝘴𝘱𝘩𝘦𝘳𝘦: Find your way in foggy surroundings strewed with trees and mysterious locations, with your lantern as your only light. Step upon traces of dark and wicked practices that will chill you to the bone. ⛧ 𝘚𝘱𝘦𝘭𝘭𝘤𝘢𝘴𝘵𝘪𝘯𝘨: Gather ingredients and create spells from your book of shadows that will help you escape your enemy's notice.

rows.name: Evo\Wave
rows.short_description: Evo\Wave is a 3D platformer featuring LAI-6, an A.I. with a goal to restore the world following the passage of MagnaVex who brought the world back to a retro era. Repair the Evo\Core to progress through the different graphic periods of the video game history!
rows.description_html: Evo\Wave is a 3D platformer featuring the little AI named LAI-6 who learns new programs and skills to restore the world! Travel through levels inspired by the different graphical eras of the video game, repair the Evo\Core and gain new skills to fight the evil MagnaVex! A 3D Collectathon evolving through different periods of video game history! The more you progress through the game while repairing the Evo\Core. The more you will experience wildly different graphics styles from the history of video games! A retro OutRun graphic style inspired by the '80s with Synthwave music reminiscent of Miami 80! A bold yet limited color palette permeates the landscape, purple skies and teal vegetation are the norm in this virtual world. Awesome music will follow you wherever you go, making you feel like you’re cruising through the neon sunset. Unlock skills like double jumping and the power of gliding through the air that will allow you to navigate through the levels and move around in new and fun ways! Collect as many collectibles as you can, from Evo\Core peripherals and Components or Facts Sheets that will give you historical anecdotes about video games! Watch out for glitches and corrupted enemies that MagnaVex will send to counter your progress! Evo\Wave is a game designed to be accessible to all age groups, both young and old, and aims to bring some LGBTQ+ representation with LAI-6, our young non-binary artificial intelligence. In addition, a lot of attention has been directed towards visual accessibility by reducing elements like flashing lights and low contrast that would prevent some people from enjoying Evo\Wave!

rows.name: The 2020 Trail
rows.short_description: The 2020 Trail is an Oregon Trail parody game which takes you on a trip through the chaotic year of 2020. Keep your resources stocked, your mood high, and make the right decisions to avoid catching the 'rona.
rows.description_html: 2020 will go down in history as one of the most disastrous years ever. Everyone alive felt the effects of the events — whether it was discrimination, politics, Mother Nature or the pandemic. To keep our heads up at Games with Geebs, we felt there was no better way to get through the chaotic times than to laugh at them. That's where The 2020 Trail comes in. “[Humor] offers a way of being sane in an insane place.” — Thomas Kuhlman Take a trip down memory lane in this Oregon Trail parody game where you traverse through the calendar year of 2020. Your decisions directly affect your mood and can make you more susceptible to catching the ‘rona. Don’t forget to stock up on toilet paper! Make decisions on how you spend the year Cook, dance, or skate to boost your mood and fend off depression Avoid catching the 'rona! Plow through pesky shoppers with carts Customize your character and time travel in style! Revisit the good, the bad, and the straight-up ridiculous events of 2020 Be THAT guy that stocks up on TP

rows.name: Over The Phone
rows.short_description: A short talking sim with choices. Get to know Harper over a handful of voice-acted calls and text chats.
rows.description_html: Over The Phone is a talking sim about a photographer named Jake who meets a girl in the unlikeliest of places, on a customer support call with his internet service provider. The game is akin to a visual novel, in that it's primarily reading / listening to the conversation and periodically making choices about what to say. Short game: ~25-30 min playthrough 2.5 endings (2 primary endings, with one having an additional choice at the end) Chill original soundtrack Harper voiced by Catsen (ttv/catsen) Choices Most choices are part of a tone system, which include a word below that describes the tone/intention of that line. Making choices of a particular type makes it more likely to have similar choices later on and fewer choices that conflict with that tone. If you played Drinks With Abbey, you're probably familiar with how unforgiving the game is when it comes to choices. You needed to pick specific ones throughout to get the 'best' ending. In OTP, that's not the case. The types of choices you make do decide which ending you get, as well as change the conversation and future choices. But it's more flexible in terms of which specific options are chosen.

rows.name: Atrius Star
rows.short_description: Bullet hell roguelite with challenging AI, fun weapons, monster infighting, and speed running.
rows.description_html: Atrius Star is a bullet hell roguelite with challenging AI, fun weapons, monster infighting, and speed running. Fly in on your helicopter, fight the monsters, and save the princess of Atrius from the evil scientist Dral. Challenging AI The monsters in Atrius Star are built upon a concept called 'orthogonal unit differentiation'. This means each unit operates in a unique way causing you to make meaningful decisions to defeat each one. Fun Weapons The weapons in Atrius Star include a chainsaw, rifle, shotgun, SMG, rocket launcher, and grenade launcher. Each weapon has its own strength, weakness, and cool down mechanic causing you to regularly switch between weapons to survive. Monster Infighting If enough chaos ensues or monsters are manipulated just right, they will start to fight each other. It's a truly satisfying event that creates laughs and saves you ammo. Speed Running With each game timed, you can get endless replayability by trying to beat your all-time best.

rows.name: ZombiesWaves
rows.short_description: Your friend is blocked! Eliminate the zombies - Open all the doors - Help your friend.
rows.description_html: Twitter : Welcome to ZombiesWaves :) The game : - You must go and rescue your friend who is stuck behind a door. For that you must open all the doors of the game to go and rescue her, but beware of the waves of zombies that will prevent you from going to help your friend. Weapons : - As soon as you eliminate zombies, you will earn money which will allow you to have better weapons, but also advantages (such as for example, the fast reload). Mystery boxes : - In the game map, you will find mystery boxes which will allow you to have weapons, grenades and mines to help you eliminate the zombies. Zombies hide powers : - When you go to eliminate zombies, some of them will drop powers (like for example 'Easy elimination', this power allows to eliminate a lot of zombies in 1 second). WARNING We decided to make the character controls quite difficult. As soon as you start playing it will be hard but as you go it will be much easier :) Thank you for your understanding So ? Ready for the adventure?

rows.name: The Sound of Fireworks: The Haiku
rows.short_description: Follow the story of Amimi Imai, an 18 year old student who's recent move from home has left her succumbed to a new high school and new life. The Sound of Fireworks: The Haiku is a single path/ending visual novel about love, acceptance, and a good ol' awkward budding teenage friendship.
rows.description_html: Hey new journal, My old journal ran out of pages, so you're holding the fort now. Let me introduce myself! My name is Amimi Imai, I'm 18, and most of my friends call me 'Hanabi'. Why? Well, I'm a big fan of fireworks! My mom loved them, and the way she always talked about them made me want to see them for myself. But you know, life happens, and I haven't had the chance to see them in person. Well...not yet at least, but we'll get to that. This year has been a doozy: I had to move to a new city for family reasons, had to leave my friends behind, and we could only communicate through our phones. Major bummer. But I had a new school and new experiences to look forward to! I had big plans to do my best and get into the best university so I could follow my dreams of being a writer. But school can be like life sometimes: hard, cruel, and unwelcoming. I knew if I just put my head down, I would get through it somehow. But that all changed, when a certain dumb, uncoordinated, but amazing guy found his way to me. Him and his haikus. You'll get what I mean. Well, I gotta run, but I'll talk to you soon! Bye-bye! -Amimi~ The Sound of Fireworks: The Haiku is the first part of a (hopeful) trilogy following the friendships, hardships, and path of Amimi, an 18 year old student who's recent move from home has left her succumbed to a new high school and new life without the friends she's had by her side. But as a few weeks pass by, Amimi gets to know Uta, another student recently transferred living the same issues that Amimi is going through. While the chemistry is, well, off to say the least, a budding friendship is soon to be made, and Amimi's high school life will change: like the night sky from the bang of a Firework. > Part 1 of The Sound of Fireworks Trilogy, TSOF: The Haiku is a single path/ending visual novel about love, acceptance, and a good ol' awkward budding teenage friendship. Length: ~40,000 words VOICE ACTORS: Amimi - Hesketts / @thehesketts Uta - Pascal Casimier / @pcasi_va Hina - Hannah Dove / @HannahDoveVA Aiko - Heidi Tabing / @HeidiTabing Kenta - Drew Kocour / @dregtheotaku Takumi - Nick Chang / @CloverHouraisan Zuki - Ken Hoang Vo / @Komi_Ken_Art

rows.reviews_html: “The Sound of Fireworks: The Haiku is an adorable story of overcoming trauma and sometimes going over your limit if you want to succeed. Down the line, it made me root heavily for our heroine to succeed even with her difficult obstacles. It possesses an extremely relatable story with a fine handful of characters and cute art.” 7/10 – Far2close - VN Plays! “What it blows in full VN functionality, it more than compensates with its heart-winning sound & poetically real expression of puppy-platonic love!” Recommended – DaRevieweD

rows.name: VR Guardians
rows.short_description: Wield your weapons and face the wrath of colossal creatures. Fight your way through a barrage of projectiles, fireballs and gargantuan teeth and claws as you stumble into the terrifying stages where the VR Guardians dwell. Are you up for the challenge?
rows.description_html: Enter the worlds of VR Guardians, where you find yourself in the belly of the beasts and awaken the colossal creatures that reside within its stages. Choose between the scorching embers of the Lava World, surrounded by flowing magma and the skeletal remains of the fallen as you fight the sleeping Fire Guardian; or dive into the depths of the Underwater World, in the middle of a sunken castle ruins as you try to avoid being the Water Guardian's next prey. VR Guardians utilizes the Oculus headset’s default control scheme along with graphical in-game instructions – allowing the users to immerse themselves into the worlds intuitively and seamlessly. Solely designed for a 360 degree view, players can delve into the intricately designed stages without a need for a lot of space as the game can be fully experienced even when sitting or standing-in-place.

rows.name: Rushmore
rows.short_description: Rushmore is a third-person, hero-focused, shooter/hack-n-slash hybrid. You play as the four Presidents of Mount Rushmore sucked into the future to face off against alien hordes with weapons and abilities inspired by American history.
rows.description_html: On earth in the far future, aliens have begun their conquest of earth in the amazing city of New Liberty. Humanity pools its resources to bring four figures from American history to the future to aid them in their resistance against these tyrannical invaders then empowers them and their weapons with a mysterious “goo” from derived from the very aliens themselves. Rushmore is a third-person, hero-focused, shooter/hack-n-slash hybrid. You play as the four Presidents of Mount Rushmore sucked into the future to face off against alien hordes with weapons and abilities inspired by American history. This was a student driven project developed at the University of Central Florida (UCF) over the course of a spring semester in 2019 by a team of 15. Since then limited additional development was done to ready the project for release.
