rows.name: Dreams Of Adventure
rows.short_description: Dreams Of Adventure brings you in a world of medival fantasy where you chose how to play and impact the world around you. Will you help a person in need? Want them to pay you for help? Perhaps... you end their life and take the bellongings...? The choice is yours!
rows.description_html: Dreams Of Adventure brings you in a world of medival fantasy where you chose how to play and impact the world around you. Will you help a person in need? Want them to pay you for help? Perhaps... you end their life and take the bellongings...? The choice is yours! Map is 150x120 squares big (The finished map will be 500x500 or even 2x(500x500) Quests 125(currently) Party member - 2 (Currently. More members will be added in future as I work) nteractive spells - (Casting spells require to be pressed in a sequence in set amount of time to work with 100% chance of it hitting) Day/Night Cycle - Unlike most of RPGMaker games, day/night here determinate if you can enter a house freely or have to pick a lock (during the night. Some events and quests will trigger at night and quest givers/quest objective will only spawn at night (e.g.: Kill 10 owls (not an actual quest in game but for sake of reference) Statuses - Hunger, Thirst and Sleep (If Hunger and thirst hits 0 your character dies. As sleep goes down, so do your stats but it's not fatal) Prison System - Pay or Do Time World Locations 35(260+ inside locations (including houses) Blackjack mini-game (for those who like to gamble and have fun on the side) 2000+ Interact-ables (bookshelf's, drawers, closets, boxes, etc) Lockpicking 1000+ items, weapons and gear combined Smelting, Weaponsmith, Armorsmith, Alchemy, Tailoring, Fishing, Leatherworking, Scribe, Inscirption, Survival, Woodcrafting, Processing, Jewewllcrafting, Cooking In-game Achievements (STEAM coming soon) Lots of random world events that trigger randomly or depending on your choices you've made along the way Fog of War - Rooms with doors are dark until you enter it. They go back to dark when you leave the room. Different Endings Purchasable houses - A place to call your own. Purchasable businesses - Earn income by owning land or busnies. Steal- You can steal items, money or gear from enemies during battle Flavorful sounds for drink, eat, sleep, armor and weapon equip. Spell Cool Downs 12 Kingdoms (not done yet) Item weight- Now items will have weight making player chose what to carry on him Bank/Storage- Players can store stuff and gold in banks for a small fee just like real life! Difficulty System - Now you can chose how you want to play the game. From Easy to Torment the enemies will have stats to make you walk pass them like a breeze or crush your very soul. 8 Classes: 1. Sellsword - An ex-soldier class that uses all kind of weapons and gear to rip and tear enemies on the battlefield. 2. Cultist - A harbinger of the dark forces. Uses various spells to afflict enemies HP and abilities. Can use blood sacrifices (kill friendly party members) to do massive damage and afflictions. 3. Paladin - Warrior of Light that strikes his foes with righteous fury. Users both abilities and spells to change the tide of battle. 4. Ranger - Utilities the nature and the environment to strike fear in enemies, unseen. Various traps and few spells that are learned from the time spent with elves. 5. Bandit - Always scheming, uses agility to strike their enemies. A bandit don't shy away form using less savory means to kill their target. 6. Cleric - Going down path of the Lord, you shy away from violence, but use your abilities to help those in need, while accidents do happen... It's a battle after all. 7. Sorcerer - Going to the school of Magic, you learn various school of spells to damage your foes from afar. 8. Commoner - A common peasant. (Not done yet)

rows.name: 避雨2🌧

rows.description_html: It is a parkour game to avoid the rain. The main character is a rabbit. You wake up in an abandoned cave, get a strange core, and then you will start your own adventure. Mr. Black Rabbit is a robot, which means he cannot touch the water, but a mystery man gives the Black Rabbit the ability to avoid water through the core. However, the mystery man needs the Black Rabbit to deliver this core to his temporary residence. Players must avoid the rain while delivering the core to the destination, but the road will encounter a variety of dangerous situations and bad weather, such as heavy rain, hail, lightning, wind, snow … This game is very simple. You only must use your four direction keys to control the character to jump, walk, slide, and fix. So, you can use your own inertia to overcome every situation.

rows.name: Retroninjacyberassassin

rows.description_html: The Cybersoul corporation has become the world's largest manufacturer and media group; using their financial power to influence world governments and create their own cyborg militia, Cybersoul becomes the only authority on the planet. Having purchased every media outlet on earth has allowed Cybersoul to maintain their control over the masses without question, except for one lone newspaper with a tenacious reporter with a fierce skepticism of the corporate giant. A newly drafted merger threatens to take ownership of the newspaper, unless, one of their own, a cyborg ninja known only by his manufacturing number, 6617, exposes the nefarious plot as he begins to discover it himself.

rows.name: Crowalt: Traces of the Lost Colony - Prologue
rows.short_description: A young adventurer Hugh Radcliff is in pursuit of one of the greatest mysteries of history: The Lost Colony. Deal with pirates, reveal conspiracies and make tough choices on your difficult journey for unveiling this mystery. Try the free prologue now!
rows.description_html: Crowalt: Traces of the Lost Colony is an adventure game that is merging the traditional storytelling with modern-day pixel art graphics. This version is a prologue of the full game. If you like this, you can buy the full version. CHASING A MYSTERY THAT IS UNEXPLAINED FOR 150 YEARS A group of people who set out to establish the first settled colony in America in 1587, mysteriously disappears a short time after arriving. They leave only an island name carved on a tree: 'Crowalt'. Now, the year is 1737. A young and ambitious adventurer Hugh Radcliff pursues the Lost Colony to make his first great discovery. Now, different people live in Crowalt, where he came to solve this mystery. He will hover around the island and definitely will get in a series of troubles to find what happened to the Lost Colony. CLASSIC POINT AND CLICK MECHANICS Collect, combine, and use items to solve puzzles. PIRATES ARE HERE TOO! Try to deal with routine pirate visitors of Crowalt and of course, enjoy funny dialogues. FOLLOW YOUR JOURNAL Hugh draws important things and takes notes regarding them in his journal. It will be updated after important events and findings during the game. MAKE CHOICES Lie or speak only the truth. COLLECT ARTIFACTS There are lots of historical items around the island, collecting them will take you to another level of… achievements!

It’s aesthetically beautiful and visually intriguing, and its engagement with surrealism and existential horror is both romantic and wryly self-aware. Anyone with a penchant for the gothic or for escape rooms may find something compelling in Dinner With An Owl, and be left wanting more.” Sufficiently Human “The music especially serves to create a very eerie atmosphere. rows.name: 7 Years War
rows.short_description: Top-Down 2D action/adventure about the French-Indian War in North America.
rows.description_html: A 2D action/explorer surrounding the events of the French-Indian War in North America. Use your knowledge to pass enemy encounters and discover the events that led to a global conflict that spanned from 1756-1763. You will guide a French Infantryman through historical events that shaped our nation. Establish trade with the local Natives for weapons, cut your way through Ohio territory, and battle the Brittish army as they try to expand their territory under rule of King George III. Players can move around a map and interact with NPCs and objects that give information then, use that information to progress in the game by shooting correct answers to enemy encounters. Make your way through enemy occupied territory and battle a young lieutenant, George Washington. Hunt beavers for pelt and trade fur with Native Americans for useful tools that cut open new pathways.

Rich & Fast Paced Gameplay Hack and slash through any demon that stands in your way. Spend your under-worldly spoils on powerful abilities and unique items! Unique Environments to Explore Fight through the numerous districts of a Hellish city in search of secrets, brawls, and leads for your missing cat; Purrsephone! A Humorous and Surreal Story After following Purrsephone through a mysterious portal, Aella finds herself in what appears to be the underworld's HR department (Hell's Resources). In order to track down her missing feline friend, she strikes a deal with this realm's exceedingly oppressive manager. What could possibly go wrong? rows.name: KingdomDefense
rows.short_description: A fantasy game that combines Tower defense, MOBA, and RPG elements. Tutorial and five game levels. Single-play only.
rows.description_html: Demonic gates have been opening across the realms of Aeons. Dark king Yaldabaoth has been released from its imprisonment, and now it seeks vengeance against the celestial beings. You are the defender of Aeon, and you must protect the holy cities of Aeon and all its protectorates. The fate of the entire creation rests on your campaign against these dark enemies. This game combines tower defense, MOBA, and RPG elements. Your objective is to defend the ally castle before the countdown timer expires. if the castle stands still after the countdown is over, the victory is yours to claim. Enemies will constantly spawn from the dark gate on the opposite side of the game field, and more powerful enemies will spawn in greater number as the countdown timer draws closer to the expiration. You can strategically plan to use the gold gained from slaughtering the enemies to maximize your chance of victory. There are five game levels and a tutorial stage to help you learn the basics of the gameplay mechanics. You can also save your progress at any time during the game.

rows.name: Traversing Traveler
rows.short_description: Play as an alchemist named Taylor using various potions find your way around and unlock new areas to talk to various townsfolk who wish to see the path between villages restored.
rows.description_html: Traversing Traveler is a game currently still in development by a small team of students. Some features may still be in progress as the game is in beta. Play as Taylor, a local alchemist in the town of Lumina. A recent disaster hit the area and now teleportation between towns is offline. Taylor decides to fix the routes by collecting runes in the areas between towns so people can travel the area again. Using potions such a bomb potion to destroy obstacles and a cloud potion to make platforms to jump between areas, Taylor has to make their way around to collect runes to restore the teleporters. As Taylor unlocks new areas people from various towns ask for help and get excited about the prospect of traveling again. Features: • Use bomb potion to blow up obstacles in your path • Create cloud platforms to jump on • Throw vine potions to climb up to higher areas • Use a shield potion to protect from damage • Interact with various NPCs that ask for help or give tasks to complete • When leaving the hub area, collect runes to fix the teleportation crystal of the next town over

rows.name: Smithworks
rows.short_description: Smithworks is a first-person 3D cooperative multiplayer game where players play as fledgling blacksmiths. It is a humorous and chaotic experience where players will need to communicate effectively in order to craft these weapons quickly before the customers get angry.
rows.description_html: You play as a new member in the Smithworks Guild named Smitta. She has always dreamed of becoming like the legendary smiths of the past. Their legacy and contributions led to their peaceful present time. However, it would seem that the guild was not as she had hoped for with it's questionable business practices and treatment of customers. Same-day blacksmithing? You have to be joking. Surely, it will get better right? Hop on with your fellow blacksmiths and friends and get through these blacksmithing contracts together. Smithworks is a team-based game that focused heavily on communication to succeed. How players decide to work together is up to them and every strategy is valid. Of course, you don't need to be perfect to succeed. In the words of the guild: 'If it looks right, then the customer won't notice'. Work in real time against the clock, to handle the heat of the customers coming in. Choose what orders to prioritize and how to do them to keep the guild and the customers happy. Features: Up to 4 player co-op Steam Achievements Voice Chat Procedurally Generated Orders Altered Levels for 1, 2, 3-4 player lobbies

rows.name: P3TT
rows.short_description: Solve puzzles by creating portals and manipulating time. Inspired by Valve's Portal and Portal 2.
rows.description_html: Do you believe in time travel? Heavily inspired by Valve's Portal and Portal 2, P3TT is an indie puzzle solving game, featuring time manipulation abilities on top of the familiar blue and orange portals. Awakening trapped in a remote facility, you must find your way out, progressing through a series of levels as you go. In order to complete each level, you must locate the exit and carefully examine your environment to understand what series of actions must be performed in order to open the doors and go through. Will you manage to escape? This game contains: Single player first person puzzle solving. Physics and time manipulations by passing objects and laser beams through various wormholes. Cumulative challenge, starting up from what you may have already seen and acquiring new controls as you advance. Fundamentals resembling Valve's Portal games, and being well familiar with them prior to playing P3TT is most highly recommended. Disclaimer: P3TT is not associated with Valve in any way, nor is distributed for commercial purposes. It was independently developed in hopes that Valve would make an official release of Portal 3 based on the ideas displayed here. Music in trailer: Aurora by Frankumjay

rows.name: Spellfarers
rows.short_description: Farm, fish, craft, and cast spells with your friends in this idyllic, magical multiplayer farming sim. Befriend the townsfolk of Wenngrove, learn their trades and stories, tend your home with your friends and Familiar, and make magic in Spellfarers.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Wenngrove! Farm, fish, craft, and cast spells with your friends in this idyllic, magical multiplayer farming sim. A Magical World Play as a Witch sent to investigate the disappearance of a fellow magical researcher, who was lost while exploring the nearby Wilds. Uncover the secrets hidden in the mysterious spellbook she left behind. Befriend the local townsfolk of Wenngrove, learn their trades and their stories, and make a beautiful home alongside your trusty Familiar. Farm at the Homestead The Homestead is your own space to customize and grow ingredients for your spells. Farm, craft and build furniture to make your hut into a home. Or maybe cook a big meal and have your friends over for a grand party - which may or may not include witchcraft! Explore With Friends Customize your character and display your bewitching personality in Spellfarers. Learn new patterns and recipes to sew yourself a new outfit. Meet new friends along the way, create a coven, and work together to forage and discover all of what Wenngrove has to offer. A Welcoming Community Many hands make light work! Teaming up with other witches can make for easier foraging and stronger spells. Whether you prefer to gather together, or go solo, Wenngrove will always welcome you.

rows.name: Lab Rags
rows.short_description: Enjoy failure as it fuels your success in Lab Rags, where you get to use your ragdoll bodies to solve puzzles!
rows.description_html: Lab Rags is a hilarious 3D puzzle game where your failure is meaningful! Build upon failed attempts to solve an assortment of puzzles. Just like life, you never know that you're moving forwards unless you make mistakes. Our labs follow the same philosophy: Use every unsuccessful attempt to improve yourself and get further. In our workplace, failure is never the end. - Teleport to the art-deco 1920's world of Lab Rags. - Take control of our fancy crash test dummy to navigate these treacherous labs. - Manipulate the properties of your previous frames to overcome dangerous traps.

rows.name: Snapshot
rows.short_description: Magic and science. Past and future. But what of the present?
rows.description_html: Based on a short story of the same name. This free short kinetic visual novel was developed for Magical Girl Game Jam 3. The heiress of an ancient magical family uses a special camera to uncover the past — both of history, and of herself.
